basic_info.description: 1010 Stanyan Street #2 is a top-floor condominium in a boutique four-unit building. The property features three bedrooms and three bathrooms across 1545 square feet of living space and a spacious private roof deck. The main level includes a chef's kitchen with a large peninsula and top-of-the-line appliances, an open-plan living and dining area with a gas fireplace, exceptional natural light, a bedroom or home office, and a full bathroom. The second level offers the primary suite with vaulted ceilings and a spa-like bathroom with an oversized shower. The level is completed with the final ensuite bedroom and in-unit washer and dryer. Additional features include multi-zone radiant floor heat, a bicycle room, and built-in speakers.
